title: Alerts column shows one name ×count chip per alert group, in API order
verifies: the incidents list 'Alerts' cell renders one 'name ×count' chip per alert group, most-fired first, instead of a bare count chip

title: More than two alert groups collapse into a +N more tooltip listing the rest
